perks.name: Radiolaria Breach
perks.description: After picking up an Orb of Power, the next time your shields are broken, gain a bonus to Health stat for a short duration and release a burst of radiolaria around you.
perks.exact:
On Orb of Power Pickup:
Grants Radiolaria Breach.
Can only trigger once per Full Heal.

Upon reaching Critical Health:
Consumes Radiolaria Breach to trigger an explosion that deals up to 360 [11] Damage over 7 meters.
+50 Health Stat for 7.5 seconds and releases 4 Radiolaria Pools 5 meters away from the user.
Radiolaria Pools deal 14 Arc Damage every 0.5 seconds.

perks.name: Collective Power
perks.description: While you have a subclass buff, dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring 5 damage instances while any Elemental Buff is active:
Spawns an Orb of Power on the user that grants 0.8?% Super Energy.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown upon spawning an Orb where additional damage instances will not count.
Only counts a hit up to once every 0.8s, meaning the perk takes AT LEAST 4 seconds to trigger. 
Consecutive triggers take a minimum of 5 seconds to reproc.

Damage Instances dealt to Immune Enemies count towards spawning Orbs.

Elemental Buffs:
Amplified, Bolt Charge | Cure, Radiant, Restoration | Devour, Invisibility, Overshield
Frost Armor | Woven Mail
And also standing in a Healing Rift for no reason
